author: Kevin Kelly
short: Music, community tools, leveling, logging, and message transformations for Red.
description: Custom Red Discord Bot cogs for native music/search/fair queues, community role menus/polls/events, XP rewards/challenges/rank cards, event logs with retained history, and expiring channel transformations. All five include guided setup and slash commands; optional SettingsHub unifies setup, health, and validated configuration backup/restore.
install_msg: Thanks for adding Kevin Cogs. List the available cogs with [p]cog list kevin-cogs, or use your chosen repository name. Setup guides: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs. AudioPlus uses native Discord voice with local FFmpeg and yt-dlp. Use [p]play, [p]community, [p]level, [p]log, and [p]owo; each cog supports slash commands.
